notes: Lead source: inbound self-serve (signup -> quickstart). CTO Sara Park is technical and wants low-lift solution. Short notes from calls: - 'On staging the chat feels sluggish, search results take ~2.5-3s which is higher than expected' - initially using default endpoints in us-west-2, but most users are east coast US; saw 80% traffic in us-east region. - App is browser-based single-page app, streaming enabled but client cancels at 25s sometimes. - Customer used a long context: full product catalog JSON pasted in prompt for retrieval -> bloated token counts. - Cost sensitivity: wants to keep monthly under $1k while hitting <500ms median latency for chat first byte (realistic goal is 500ms-1s). - Interested only in Hosted API for now, may consider Dedicated if scale grows. SE recommendations provided in call: region switch to us-east-1, reduce prompt prefix to preprocessed embeddings instead of raw JSON, set client timeout to 60s for streaming and 30s for non-streaming, enable token quota + shorter max_tokens (e.g., 256), experiment with model variant lower-latency profile. Customer responded: 'we don't want to manage infra, but we need predictable response times.' Action items: Diego to send a concise perf checklist (region, timeout, prompt length guidelines, streaming settings), schedule 1:1 debug session this week, ask for sample request IDs for traces, follow up with billing estimate if they move to paid tier.
prompt_guidance: Trim catalog payloads: move to embeddings + retrieval instead of pasting raw JSON into prompt
Aim for <= 800 tokens in prompt + instructions for chat to keep latency consistent
Use concise system prompts and avoid heavy examples in every request
If you must include examples, batch them server-side and cache shared prefixes
perf_recommendations_shared: Region: recommend switching production to us-east-1 (closest to majority users); if EU, use eu-west-1
Client timeouts: streaming clients -> 60s; non-streaming sync calls -> 30s; server-side retry backoff 500ms x 3
Model selection: pick lower-latency variant for UI interactions; reserve higher-quality for async batch jobs
Token limits: set max_tokens to 256 for chat responses; use sampling params that reduce decode time
